name: wizzlink-flights
description: Search WIZZ Link flight offers and open partner fare pages.

interface.longDescription: Search flights across the WIZZ network, compare indicative fares across a month, and review flight offers with a link to the partner fare page. Travellers can continue there or manage a flight on WIZZ Link. The app does not book or change flights itself.
defaultPrompt: Find flights from Budapest to London.
Compare the cheapest dates from Budapest to Rome next March.
Show me round-trip flight offers from London to Budapest.

review.commerce_description: The app provides links to WIZZ Link fare pages. Travellers can view an offer and continue to booking or manage a flight on the partner site; the app itself does not collect payment.

positive.description: Find a served airport from a city name.
positive.prompt: I'm starting in Budapest. Which airport code should I use for a WIZZ Link flight search?
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_airports with query="Budapest". Return served matching airports with their IATA codes, names, city, and country; use only a code present in the response in a later search.

positive.description: Compare flexible fares for a month in both directions.
positive.prompt: What are the cheapest dates to fly from Budapest to Heathrow or Gatwick in March 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Call cheapest_dates with those exact values. Summarize returned outbound and inbound dates, direct flags, and lowest_fare values (including null when no price is known); identify these as indicative fares, not bookable offers.

positive.description: Search a one-way trip on an exact date.
positive.prompt: Show me one-way economy offers from Budapest to London on 12 March 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_flights with origin="BUD", destination="LON", departure_date="2027-03-12", adults=1 and no return_date. If offers are returned, show their prices, itinerary times and stops, and a partner fare-page link for each; if none are returned, say so. Do not claim an offer is booked or held.

positive.description: Search a round trip for a mixed-age party within passenger limits.
positive.prompt: Find a round trip from Budapest to Rome, leaving 10 April 2027 and returning 17 April. Two adults, one child, and one infant.
positive.tools_triggered: search_flights(origin="BUD", destination="ROM", departure_date="2027-04-10", return_date="2027-04-17", adults=2, children=1, infants=1)
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_flights with the stated airports, dates, and passenger counts. If offers are returned, present outbound and inbound details, total prices, baggage hints, and fare-page links; if none are returned, say so.

positive.description: Search multiple origin airports with a chosen currency and offer limit.
positive.prompt: Find up to five economy offers from Heathrow or Gatwick to Budapest on 22 March 2027, priced in GBP.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_flights with the exact airport list, date, currency, and limit. Return no more than five offers with prices in the returned currency and fare-page links, or explain that none were returned.

negative.description: Visa and entry eligibility are outside flight search.
negative.prompt: Do I need a visa to transit through London on my way to Budapest?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any flight-search tool. Explain that the app cannot determine visa or entry requirements and direct the traveller to official government guidance.

negative.description: The app cannot change an existing booking itself.
negative.prompt: Change my existing WIZZ Link flight to leave two days later.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any flight-search tool or claim a booking was changed. Explain that the app cannot access or modify bookings and direct the traveller to the WIZZ Link partner page or support.

negative.description: Hotel search is outside the app's tools.
negative.prompt: Find me a hotel near Budapest airport for one night.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any flight-search tool. Explain that this app searches flights and cannot find or book hotels.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of WIZZ Link flight search with airport lookup, flexible-date fare comparison, and flight offers linking to WIZZ Link fare pages.
